cases.name: Stephanie Giselle García
cases.narrative:
She was (also) beaten, she had many blows, bullets in each arm and in the feet and in the stomach ,” her grandmother said.

On 4/2/2022 in the early morning, she called her mother asking for help: “Mommy, help me, he just shot me,” her grandmother says (to Telemundo) she said on the phone. García tried to calm her mother by saying that she was fine but she was afraid because she was bleeding from her leg. At that moment he snatched her phone from her. “I'm going to kill her ,” she said. 

When her family arrived at the home, located in the city of Converse, northwest of San Antonio, the place was cordoned off, because she had managed to call the police. Her family watched as she was carried out on a stretcher, seriously injured, but she died in hospital.

Bexar County Sheriff Javier Salazar said police received a call at 1:15 in the morning from a woman who was asking for help after being shot. “They returned the call, a man answered and verified that he had indeed shot a woman inside the residence and that her intention was to shoot him again and then commit suicide,” Salazar said, according to local outlet KSAT12.

Officers heard gunshots upon arriving at the scene, so they entered by force. They found García on the bathroom floor with multiple wounds , and her boyfriend next to her, dead from a gunshot.
